app.name: vocab-coach
app.tagline: Turn the words you care about into words you actually use.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: AI providers, study settings and today's AI usage. Changes apply at once, without restarting the app.

ai.title: AI providers
ai.intro: Free tiers only. Keys stay in the .env file on this computer: the app never shows them again and never sends them to the browser.

privacy.title: Before you save
privacy.body: Only your turns are saved. To analyse them, your turns and the end of the other speaker's turn that comes before each of them ({{chars}} characters at most) are sent to the AI provider. On a free plan, this content may be used to improve its models.

transcripts.saveHint: Preview the text and choose your turns first; then you can save.

detail.title: Your conversation and its analysis
detail.analysingHint: A long conversation needs several AI calls and can take a few minutes. Your turns are saved: you can wait here.
detail.notAnalysed: Your turns are saved but were not analysed.
detail.notAnalysedIncomplete: Your turns are saved but were not analysed: the AI's answer could not be used.
detail.notAnalysedReason: Your turns are saved but were not analysed: {{reason}}.
detail.noMemory: The conversation you pasted is not kept after a reload, so the other speaker's turns cannot be sent as context. Analyse your turns without that context, or paste the conversation again.
detail.withoutContext: Analyse without the other speaker's context

history.title: My conversations
history.intro: The conversations you recorded, newest first.
history.empty: No conversation yet. Paste the first one.

errorLog.title: Error log
errorLog.intro: Every mistake found in your texts, reviews and drills. Open one to correct it, link it to a term or delete it.

list.empty: Your error log is empty. Write a text, answer a review or add an error by hand.

detail.title: An error in your log
detail.noOriginal: No sentence was stored with this error.
detail.wrongNotFound: The incorrect form could not be located in the sentence.
detail.openText: Open the text it comes from
detail.explanationNote: Changing the explanation removes its French translation.
detail.unchanged: Nothing to save: no field has changed.
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this error from your log? The statistics will no longer count it.
detail.openDrill: Open the drill it comes from

manual.title: Add an error
manual.intro: Note a mistake you noticed yourself. It joins your log like the others.
manual.prefilled: Filled in from your shadowing: read it, change what is wrong, then add it. Nothing is saved until you do.
manual.original: The sentence where you made it (optional)
manual.wrongNotInOriginal: The incorrect form must appear in the sentence.
manual.sameAsCorrection: The correction must differ from the incorrect form.

categories.title: Error categories
categories.intro: The taxonomy your errors are sorted in. Add your own subcategories, and decide on those the AI proposes.
categories.proposalsIntro: The AI suggests these subcategories. Accept one to use it, or reject it: its errors move to the parent category.
categories.rejectConfirm: Rejecting “{{label}}” moves its errors to the parent category.
categories.rejected_one: “{{label}}” rejected. {{count}} error moved to the parent category.
categories.rejected_other: “{{label}}” rejected. {{count}} errors moved to the parent category.
categories.rejectedNone: “{{label}}” rejected. No error had to move.
categories.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and “_”, 2 to 41 characters, starting with a letter.
categories.slugInvalid: The code name must follow the rule below the field.

drills.title: Targeted drills
drills.intro: Short exercises on one error category, written by the AI from your own mistakes. A wrong answer is added to your error log.

form.title: New drill
form.preparingHint: The AI is writing them; this takes a few seconds.
form.noCategories: No category can be practised yet.
form.fromSession: This drill is part of today's session.
form.unavailable: The drill could not be created: {{reason}}. Nothing was saved; you can try again.
form.incomplete: The AI's answer could not be used. Nothing was saved; you can try again.

list.title: Your drills
list.empty: No drill yet. Create the first one above.
list.emptyFiltered: No drill in this category yet.

result.label: Result
result.errorNote: The correction is exact. If you think your answer was correct, you can delete this error from your log.
